_comment: Public, committed config for sector-watch. Edit freely. Secrets (webhook URLs, tokens) live in config.local.json — gitignored, never committed.
_test_mode_note: While true: subject is prefixed with '[TEST] ', sender + recipient are both chauhan_intern@meteoracapital.com (self-send loop). Flip to false once we're ready to send to a different recipient.

sender._note: The email send-as-me should be configured as. The SKILL.md calls `whoami` before sending and aborts on mismatch.

recipient._note: Two recipients during test period. Comma-separated string OR list; the SKILL.md splits on ',' when calling send-as-me which expects a list.

_subject_examples: Test mode:  '[TEST] [Autonomous Trucking] Meteora Daily - May 22, 2026'

schedule._mode_note: Changed from rotation to all-active. Each weekday sends one email PER active sector (one sector per email — that part is unchanged). With 5 active sectors today, that's 5 emails per weekday. Paused sectors stay skipped.

news._window_note: Pull news from the past 48 hours only. Filter results by published date; drop anything older than now - window_hours.
news._deal_keywords_note: Universal deal-detection keywords. The runner combines these with each sector's context (sector name + a top keyword) to do a second search pass and populate the 'Deals (past 48 hrs)' section. If the second pass returns no results, that section renders 'No deal news in past 48 hrs.'

dedupe._dedupe_note: After each successful send, the runner appends today's URLs to the state file under {sector: {YYYY-MM-DD: [urls]}}. Before composing today's email, the runner reads state and filters out any URL emailed for this same sector in the past `lookback_days` days. Older entries are pruned automatically.

send._primary_note: Uses the send-as-me MCP plugin. Must be installed and configured(email='...') + signed in.
send._fallback_note: Used only when send-as-me is unavailable. Requires config.local.json with power_automate_webhook_url set.
